DETAILS
Annual food waste diverted from landfills and incinerators in kitchens and cafes at Google’s 
offices globally. We consider sending “zero food waste to landfill” as 99% diversion of food 
waste from landfills and incinerators via composting, anaerobic digestion, or other on-site 
processing—which goes further than industry standards for Zero Waste to Landfill.
